svg.title: aws-purple-range: attack, detect, respond pipeline
svg.desc: A four-stage pipeline. Stratus Red Team detonates an ATT&CK technique; CloudTrail's multi-region trail records the API call; CloudWatch metric filters and alarms detect it; response is either the responder Lambda via SNS or an analyst Logs Insights query. The trail, log group, metric filters, alarms, SNS, and responder Lambda are all defined in the terraform/logging stack.
